name: comp-295
title: Social Mention Notification
description: A mention notification card. A round avatar sits beside a sentence with the person and project in bold, a timestamp below, and Accept and Decline buttons at the foot.
use: A specific person is named in a mention and the reader can accept or decline on the spot.
avoid: The avatar, names and time are hardcoded, and neither decision is wired to anything.
a11y: The photo has alt text and the close is named, but Accept and Decline are not wired to any action. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered rounded card with a soft shadow holds a circular photo at the left, then pale text with two bold names, a small grey timestamp, a light filled Accept button and a darker outlined Decline button. A grey X sits at the top right.
behaves: Hovering either bold name underlines it and the close cross brightens on hover. Pressing Accept, Decline or the cross does nothing because no handlers are attached.
customise: The avatar URL, names, timestamp and button labels are written into the file; there are no props and the width cap is fixed.
weight: light: One small photo, a short paragraph and two buttons.
